findings.observation: Checkpoint arbitration places the absolute Deadline after continuously ready authenticated sources in every mode.
findings.impact: An authenticated local producer can indefinitely delay checkpoint timeout, shutdown, coordinator termination, and cleanup.
findings.recommendation: Give the absolute deadline unconditional priority and test sustained PlayerState with no correlated response reaches CheckpointTimeout and bounded teardown.

findings.observation: After eight control events, realtime always precedes heartbeat, allowing an eight-control-plus-one-realtime cycle forever.
findings.impact: Simultaneous authenticated control and realtime streams can starve lease maintenance.
findings.recommendation: Use independent budgets or rotate priority so overdue heartbeat is bounded; test simultaneous continuous control and realtime with due heartbeat.
evidence: active service-first orders realtime before heartbeat
existing test serializes heartbeat before lifecycle frames

findings.observation: Realtime events precede Activate in all cutover modes, so continuous valid lifecycle traffic can prevent activation until bounded-buffer failure.
findings.impact: A busy valid server stream can reliably terminate checkpoint-overlapped startup rather than complete Ready cutover.
findings.recommendation: Bound post-Ready draining and then prioritize activation while preserving watermark and FIFO; add continuous-lifecycle cutover regression.
